title: Purity coefficient conventions
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with $p$ prime, $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and $k$ its fixed algebraic closure. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ contained in the fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$, and put
$$
 A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n
$$
as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].

For a $k$-scheme $Y$, use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The finite coefficient category $D^b_c(Y,A)$ is the bounded constructible category of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. At integral coefficients use $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with its derived completeness and a single cohomological interval for all finite reductions; its ambient coefficient ring sheaf is $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_j(A_{E,j})_Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. The rational category $D^b_c(Y,E)$ is the scalar localization of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and $D^b_c(Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ is the common-stage category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Use the finite-Tor subcategories $D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ for $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ exactly as in [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]: at the integral stage the Tor interval is uniform in all reductions, and at the two field stages $D^b_{ctf}=D^b_c$.

Use the derived pullback, tensor product and internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], on the domains specified there, and the cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^r$ of [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For a separated finite-type $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], use the finite-level compact-support direct image $Rf_!$ of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], its higher-coefficient constructions of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and the constructible exceptional inverse image $Rf^!$ of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], with the adjunction $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$ on the bounded constructible categories specified in that definition. Use the exchange and projection maps of [def-exchange-projection], on its stated domains and with its specified comparison data. These conventions name the functors and maps; preservation and invertibility assertions are the separate statements about them.

Let $\Lambda_Y$ denote the coefficient unit: $(A_{E,n})_Y$ in degree zero at finite level, $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ at the integral level, and its rationalized or common-stage image at the field levels. Use the coefficient twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] for every $m\in\mathbf Z$:
$$
 K(m)=K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_Y}\Lambda(m)_Y.
$$
Here $\otimes^L_{\Lambda_Y}$ is the derived tensor product of sheaves of $\Lambda_Y$-modules exactly as specified in [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] (over the completed sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ at the integral level); for $\Lambda\in\{E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ it is formed on an integral representative, as there. Smooth of relative dimension $d\geq0$ has the meaning of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Statements and constructions in the finite-coefficient part of the purity chapter are made for $\Lambda=A$; the $\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ versions are the derived-complete, rationalized and common-stage coefficient transports specified in the chapter's transport section.

Use the canonical Weil structures on the twists of [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists]. The geometric-Frobenius normalization on the coefficient line over $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is the scalar action of [lem-pur-twist-frobenius-scalar]: $q^{-1}$ on $\Lambda(1)$, $q^{-m}$ on $\Lambda(m)$, and $q^m$ on $\Lambda(-m)$ for $m\geq0$, compatibly with finite reduction and scalar extension.

For a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$, with structure morphism $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, define
$$
 \omega_{Y,\Lambda}:=Ra_Y^!\Lambda_{\operatorname{Spec}k}.
$$
Here $Ra_Y^!$ is the constructible exceptional inverse image just specified; no exceptional-adjoint admissibility datum is added.

proof.text: The quotient arithmetic needs only divisibility: the uniformizer to the ENat.toNat of its multiplicity divides ell by pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity and ENat.natCast_toNat_le_self. Raise this divisibility to n/e and use e*(n/e)=n. Ideal.span_singleton_pow and Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem make the exponent zero in the quotient, and ULift.up transports the equality.

Forgetting module scalars is additive sectionwise. Use the existing sheaf coinduction adjunction to obtain finite colimits and the extension/restriction scalar adjunction over the integers to obtain finite limits. The coefficient forgetful/coinduction adjunction also gives preservation of sheafification by the Mathlib adjunction theorem.

For the degree-zero comparison, use the constant-sheaf/terminal-evaluation adjunction in module and abelian sheaves. Evaluation at 1 identifies Hom_A(A,M) and Hom_Z(ULift Z,M); naturality of constantCommuteCompose and constantSheafAdj_counit_w identify this bijection with precomposition by integerToConstant. Embed F into an injective I and take its cokernel Q. The two Ext long exact sequences give right-exact rows Hom(X,I) to Hom(X,Q) to Ext^1(X,F) and Hom(Z,U I) to Hom(Z,U Q) to Ext^1(Z,U F). Underlying abelian acyclicity gives the last zero term in the second row, via the proved SheafCohomologyRightDerived comparison. Exact-functor mapping commutes with Ext composition and the extension class, so these rows commute with the canonical comparison. Apply the right-exact short five lemma, using degree-zero bijectivity, to obtain moduleClassToAbelian_bijective.

Recover characteristic p of k0 from its cardinality p^a using charP_of_card_eq_prime_pow, and transfer characteristic to k by the injective algebra map. Since ell is a distinct prime its cast is nonzero and hence a unit in k. Map that unit to global sections via GammaSpecIso and the structure morphism, then take its Kummer-level power; map it to each stalk via the top-open germ.

split_report.summary: Read the current blueprint_update and its main-20261015 source plus the unit. Split this definition by explicitly naming the existing definitions of its coefficient datum, four coefficient categories and units, finite-Tor conditions, derived operations, compact supports at every stage, exceptional adjunction, exchange/projection maps, twists and relative dimension. Added the existing theorem giving the Frobenius scalar normalization. Corrected the implicit domain of the final dualizing-object notation to separated finite-type schemes and used the completed integral unit. No new nodes, no theorem duplicated, no purity route changed, and no Lean attachment claimed. Maintainer reader: the twist tensor product now follows def-coefficient-twists-detailed only (one meaning), and the unneeded same-unit tool_uses entry was removed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N9-dc9ca707e (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item against main-20261015 def-pur-conventions (order 2233), its unit sk-def-purity-conv and all 21 cited statements. Four checks: the integral category has a single interval for all reductions; rationalization and the Qlbar stage add no Karoubi completion; Rf_!, Rf^! and Ex/PF are used on exactly their stated domains (separated finite-type k-morphisms, S=Spec k, no ambient datum); twists are defined for every m with duals at m<0, and the Frobenius scalar q^{-m} holds for all m in Z. No cycle: a graph traversal from all 21 dependencies never reaches the item. The omega_{Y,Lambda} restriction to separated finite-type Y is forced by the domain of def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image and matches the unit and def-trf-dualizing-complex. Every citer that uses omega_X takes a_X separated and of finite type, so this is not a weakening. Two repairable faults, fixed in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-smooth-purity/def-pur-conventions.json. (1) E6, two meanings: the twist paragraph cited def-coefficient-twists-detailed for K(m) but then made the integral tensor the completed R-lim tensor of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom. That is a different construction, and no node proves the two agree. The sentence now uses the twist node's tensor product over the completed sheaf, formed on integral representatives at E and Qlbar. (2) The tool_uses entry for lem-pur-twist-frobenius-scalar was removed: that lemma is in the item's own unit and a definition has no proof steps. No tool_uses accepted. No new nodes and none dropped. Small cases checked: n=1, m=0, m<0, d=0, Y=Spec k, Y empty, a non-separated Y, and an infinite disjoint union of points.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
